reviews.text: Truly cannot thank this place enough for how much they have helped our pupper. He was adopted and had a lot of health issues so making sure he was properly trained was important to us. We just finished the day training program and have been thoroughly impressed throughout the process. The progress that has happened is like night and day and we are continuing to utilize their alumni benefits to continue day training.  They have an easy communication process and they provide awesome photos and instructional videos for each session. We were mainly paired with Charlotte and she was an excellent teacher and made us feel comfortable and confident as we also learned the training tips and tools. Our doggo Chauncey absolutely loved her and the team (Mikayla and Blake!), he would get so excited in the morning when he knew he was going to school. Cannot say enough good things about our experience, we will continue to use their services as an alumni and excited to continue to learn from them!

When you work with Connected Canine you’re not only training your pup, you’re also building a better relationship with them.  Our young pup Shadow started with a three week board and train session and made remarkable progress.  As a highly reactive dog, she returned to us with just a few rough edges to work on.  And where Connected Canine REALLY shines is in the “after care.”  We received additional private training sessions and attend weekly alumni training.  Furthermore, we’ve enrolled Shadow in a once weekly daycare session that is about both repetition and new environments/stimuli.  It’s through this after care that Connected Canine is creating more than well trained dogs; they are building a community of dogs and their owners who challenge, encourage, and celebrate each other.  Thanks, Connected Canine!
Sara and her team are great and very compassionate when training or boarding.

Love the whole team. They have really made a difference for my dog and the whole family. My dog used to be afraid of thunder, loud noises on a walk. Now he has so much more confidence and overall a happier dog. Thank you so much to everyone. I`ll be moving towards the canine good citizen now to make my pup ready for public on a regular basis

Everyone at Connected Canine is thoughtful, caring and always takes excellent care of my dog. I never have to worry about him when he boards with them and he always comes back happy and healthy! Thanks all!

Took my 2 year old Beagle to Connected Canine, Blake, for some impulse control training that would help him complete his service dog training.  He went to their day school training one day each week for two months and he was successful in overcoming his issues and passed all his testing needed to be endorsed by Certify Canine.  The trainers, information and interaction with everyone was excellent.  It was helpful and reassuring receiving photos and videos of training in each session so I could refer to them in my training at home.  I especially appreciate the additional access to continued training and help.  Top tier training organization.
Great and caring trainers!  Very impressive all around.

We have learned as much as our dog through our relationship with Connected Canine. We have a lovely- yet spirited- pit bull puppy who has now gone though 3 weeks of board and train bootcamp (with Sarah and Blake) and is attending Saturday group classes each week (with Blake and Erin). Shadow has nailed the basics when there are limited distractions, but still struggles when there is too much fun happening around her.  The free alumni classes are the perfect way to keep up her training around other people and dogs. It’s a fantastic and patient community!  We continue to see her learning every week!  And we are learning how to stay relaxed while she’s working.  No small feat when your puppy weighs 63 pounds and could pull a sled!

We highly recommend this team of trainers!  They mean business, but do it with incredible love and joy!

I cannot say enough amazing things about Connected Canine.  I was looking for a place where my dog could get his energy out and learn obedience.  He has come so far and is a completely different dog. It was so reassuring knowing that when I left my dog he was in good hands. Blake and Charlotte did such a wonderful job each session and really covered what my dog Tucker needed. After each session they went over all the new and amazing things Tucker learned and how I can continue to build on it. I love how they keep me posted and updated with his progress and I can watch videos of how hes doing and also refer back so I know what I'm doing is right. Overall, so impressed and so happy. Absolutely love them and recommend!

We can’t thank the team at Connected Canine enough for everything they’ve done for Ruby.

Before training, Ruby struggled with strangers coming into our home and made it very clear that she did not like cats or other small animals. We knew she was a great dog, but we also knew we needed help understanding how to work with her.

Sara, Blake, Erin, and the entire team were incredible throughout the two weeks Ruby was with them. Their communication was excellent, and they took the time to explain not just what they were doing, but why. They never made us feel embarrassed or judged for Ruby’s behavior. Instead, they helped us better understand our working dog and gave us the tools and confidence to continue her training at home.

Ruby has already made noticeable progress. We know there’s still plenty of work ahead, but we’re excited to keep building on the foundation they’ve given us. We’re also happy to know just how much Ruby loved Sara, Erin, and Blake, it gave us so much peace of mind knowing she was cared for by people she trusted and enjoyed being around.

We’re incredibly grateful to Sara and her team for the care, patience, and dedication they showed our beloved Roo. We look forward to continuing to work with Connected Canine as Ruby grows, and we wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for knowledgeable, compassionate trainers.

Thank you for helping us become better handlers and giving Ruby the opportunity to succeed.

Sara is AMAZING! Our daughter has brain cancer and Nyx is her best friend, but hes 75 lbs and very hyper. Sara worked with him for 6 weeks and he has amazing impulse control now! He is able to support her better, and it allows caregivers to come to the house without being body slammed. I would recommend her to anyone!

We loved working with Erin doing the Homebase program. She is so patient and answered many many questions to help us with our boy Indy, who is high energy and needed some help with reactivity and being calm in public. We still have a lot to work on, but I feel a lot more confident working with him on my own. I’m excited to continue with the alumni training to reinforce and build on what we learned. Thanks so much!

Sara and the connected canine team are the best in the Valley. Great place to board your four legged family members. My dogs never want to leave when I come back to pick them up. I especially like that they have people on staff with vet tech skills so my senior dog is well taken care of.

Edit: this was over a year ago and her dog still acts fearful and will have house accidents. She has stopped using the ecollar and now has a dog that won’t listen and is scared of its own shadow. My friend is non confrontational and wants nothing to do with this company hence why you haven’t heard from her. I think there are far better options out there that are positive only and don’t rely on such tools to get dogs to listen.

My best friends dog came back after a board and train and has been terrified since. He has been peeing in the house and anytime she puts the ecollar on him he runs away scared. Not sure what happened behind closed doors but I can only assume the worst.

I’ve never felt truly comfortable leaving my pup with anyone until I found Connected Canine! My 60lb baby, Freddy, is a handful and a bit of a nervous boy, so finding Sara and her team has been an absolute game-changer for us. From Doggy Daycare to boarding, Freddy has not only been well cared for but has also started coming out of his shell. Seeing his confidence grow has been amazing! I can’t recommend Connected Canine enough for anyone looking for a trustworthy and loving place for their pup.

** UPDATE**
We recently completed a board and train program at Connected Canine, and the results have been incredible. Our dog Freddy has gone from anxious to confident and well-behaved, which has greatly improved our family dynamic. Thanks to the training, we now feel confident taking him on outings like the farmers market and pet-friendly stores, and we feel well-equipped to support him moving forward.

After reading some of the other reviews, I also wanted to add some context about our experience with the e-collar. It was recommended because of Freddy's specific needs and was never presented as a replacement for training. Sara and her team emphasized from the very beginning that continued training and consistency from both the owner and the dog are what lead to long-term success.

The e-collar has simply become the clearest communication tool we've used with Freddy. Our Dogtra collar has 127 stimulation levels, and the highest we've ever needed is 17, which we use very rarely. Most of the time, Freddy responds to verbal commands because he understands what's being asked of him. The training gave us the tools and confidence to communicate with him more effectively, and we've continued practicing those skills at home. For our family, it has been one of the most valuable investments we've made in Freddy's well-being.
Thank you Joseph! Coco is such a good boy!

Just wanted to share how appreciative I am of Sara and her staff with Archie. He is hesitant at best with most people and truly has about 5 people he trusts and is calm with, but amazingly he always comes back from his time boarding happy and excited and in great spirits. How she does it I truly don’t know but I do know that anytime I have to board big Arch for travel he is in great hands. Thank you all for all you do and your attention to detail and knowing how he is and what works best for him, that alone is priceless and much appreciated!

Sara and her team have been amazing trainers for our family! We needed help when we rescued a 2yr old GSP and they provided top notch support. We were dealing with confidence issues and Sara’s team recommended a 2 week sleep away camp at her house which worked wonders. It gave us a good foundation which we were able to build on when she returned home. The homework they gave us worked very well and they also came out to our house for some touch up training when we got stuck.

Sara and team did such a great job with our GSP, we hired them again to help us train our brand new Bernedoodle puppy. We’ve had a number of puppies in the past and used various trainers but Sara’s team tops them all with their attention to detail, service, and results. I cannot recommend them enough!
We’ve worked with Connected Canine with several of our dogs and have had consistently wonderful experiences. They are kind, patient and results driven. We will definitely use them again!
We've been using Connected Canine for a while now and have had only great experiences.
Great team!
Sara and her team always do a great job with our dog, Sadie. She always comes back happy and healthy after staying with them.

My little Buster loves coming to Connected Canine and interacting with Sara and the trainers.  He also learned new ‘tricks’ and is calmer after a month long board and train. Proud of little Buster and his new Canine Good Citizen skills.

I use Sara’s boarding service for our puppy whenever we travel, and I’ve been truly happy with their service. The facility is very clean and well-maintained, and the staff are friendly, professional, and attentive.

I’ve been bringing my extremely anxious and not confident boxer-mix (5 yrs old) to Connected Canine for board and train for several months almost weekly when I travel for work.
Sara and her team have worked wonders with my little potato. Every week, her confidence grows. And, she actually LOVES being with the Connected Canine team.
I had contacted other trainers who had very little patience for my sweet girl.
Sara and her team not only have patience for her, but they seek to understand her and create an environment in which she feels safe and can thrive.
Connected Canine has been a phenomenal fit for us, and we would highly recommend them!

If we could give them a million stars, we would. They’ve been beyond incredible with our dogs and we truly cannot believe how much progress our pups have made. But even more importantly to us - as a business, they have gone so far above and beyond for us and our pups at every opportunity. AND they do such amazing work training dogs who are waiting for a family to find them. We truly have endless positive things to say about them, would recommend them to anyone and everyone. 1,000,000/10 ⭐️

I wish I could give this place a 100 stars. Since day one that we met Sara and entered her home, which is also her business, I have been truly amazed, impressed, and truly grateful. You see this cute smiling boy? This is our Champie. He loves us but he does not like any other humans. I should say he didn't like any other humans until we found Sara. Champie loves going to connected canine. He gets to play and run around and feel safe while we're away. Sara and her team take the time to socialize and play with him. He always seems so happy.

I'd like to also speak to the lonely 1 one star review that was given to connected canine. I too, was very skeptical at first when I wasn't able to see where they were kenneled. However it was explained about the insurance. And we went on faith and other reviews that first time. Since then, we've shared our succrss story with so many others including the rescue we got Champie from. They are so stringent and particular on where and who boards and trains their dogs before adoption that there is no way they would even consider, never mind contract and use Sarah and connected canine without her meeting the utmost of standards and expectations of ethics, care, and environment.
I owe Sarah and her team a world of gratitude because without them, we would not  be able to enjoy and cherish time with our fsmilirs sll of which live out-of-state.

These pics are all from Sara and her team while staying with them

Thank you from the bottom of this dog-mom's heart ❤️.
Sara, Jada and the gang are great. They worked with both my dogs and brought out the best. They proved that any dog can be trained.....the owners on the other hand..... Highly recommend!!

We did a 4 week board and train with Connected Canine for our 11 month old 82lb “puppy” and we are SO HAPPY with his behavior since he’s been home! He is an alpha male, smart, stubborn dog and he is absolutely a different dog in the best ways since we picked him up. The trainers have all been fantastic but Erin is the one who worked 1:1 with our dog and we’ve already had two follow up sessions with her, mainly for us to understand what he’s learned and how to best coach him going forward. We have young kids and we knew we needed a well trained dog for everyone’s sanity. Would absolutely do the program again, and in fact we are boarding him here again in a few weeks during a trip. It’s nice to know he’ll be well cared for and around people who care about him!

Sara and her team run a great boarding and training program. She’s easy to communicate with and my dog always comes back happy and healthy. We’ve worked with her on training too and she is wonderful and has great tools to use! I’ve recommended Connected Canine to 2 friends and both have had great experiences. Five stars for sure!
So glad to have found Connected Canine. Our older dog and new puppy thoroughly enjoyed their stay and came home happy!

I can’t say enough good things about Sara and her team! My dog, Freddie, used to be very reactive and difficult to manage. After working with the trainers (big thanks to Jada and Blake), he’s now calm, well-behaved, and such a good boy. The training methods were clear, effective, and tailored to Freddie’s needs. I’m so grateful for the transformation and would definitely recommend Connected Canine to anyone looking for real results.

My Rotti Rex enjoyed his stay! Found this place thanks to an awesome Dog trainer named Alex ! Highly recommend checking them out.  Drop off and pick up was a breeze! Everyone is very nice here and welcoming! Rex will be back

We just finished a board and train with our dog, Kuro. We felt supported by Sara from day 1, when she had a 10 minute phone call with me and gave me advice about my dog’s anxiety. Our situation became incredibly unique when our other dog ended up receiving a cancer diagnosis and having to undergo limb amputation. Sara immediately offered to extend his stay after his initial board and train to allow for our other dog to fully heal. This took an indescribable amount of stress off of our shoulders. We were sent home at pickup with an incredibly extensive packet of information and games to play with our dog. We are looking forward to our private sessions to continue fine tuning Kuro’s training. Thank you for your compassion and understanding! We wouldn’t have been able to navigate this situation without you!

We are so grateful to have found Connected Canine for our dog Dobby! Sara and her team are the best and we feel totally confident leaving Dobby there with them whether it’s for a short weekend or a long trip. He’s been a really anxious nervous dog most of his life (and afraid of men), but he is so comfortable and happy at Sara’s and loves her husband too. He always comes back home calm and happy and a lot of his anxious habits have actually faded since taking him to Connected Canine. It’s been rather remarkable and we are so grateful!! I also appreciate that she has package deals which makes boarding more affordable.

I honestly can't say enough great things about Sara and the Connected Canine certified trainers that she has working with the pups every day. My two golden retrievers (Nate and Andy AKA @golden_nandyboys) are 9 months old, they are brothers from same litter, and literally were a golden tornado of crazy! While they still have their personalities and definitely know how to play hard, they are so much tamer around our house and out in public. Jada and Erin were an incredible duo of trainers who worked with my boys every day. They taught them how to walk on a leash, how to sit and go down on command. They taught them how to behave out in public by taking them all over the city like PetsMart, Culinary Gangster restaurant, the Fashion Square Mall,  TJ Maxx, Cabelas, the park and more places I can't remember to list. They also got to go to a farm and meet a horse! They taught them recall, so they can be up to 100ft from us and come when we call their name. And now they are teaching us so none of this training goes to waste. They cared for our boys like they were their own. Nate had some diarrhea and Sara made sure to give him some fiber and meds to firm up his poop, he was also car sick so she made sure he had some Dramamine to help with his sickness on road trips. They taught them to not fear or get upset when they are in their crates. They have made a 1000% difference for them and us and I owe them dearly for the hard work they have done with them. Our boys were there for 5 weeks, it was hard not seeing them, but they kept us updated through Instagram and FB stories, as well as detailed messages at the end of each week with what they are working on, how they are doing, and photos and videos. They just do a stupendous job. I researched soooo many places, I also toured 3 places, and interviewed 2 others. I posted a message on the Scottsdale Living FB group looking for suggestions for dog training and Sara reached out to me. We interviewed them at her house where they stay and train, and knew that was the place they needed to go. It seemed welcoming, comfortable, the staff was knowledgeable, and I love that they are not cookie cutter trainers, each pup is different so they cater the training to the pup and their needs. We will DEFINITELY continue our relationship with them. They offer alumni meetups and events, as well as additional training outside the 5 weeks the boys were there.

Thank you Connected Canine for loving our boys like one of your own. 💗
My wife and I take Wyatt for day training 3 times a week. He is so happy to see the trainers when we drop him off. He will be the bestest boy in time with Connected Canine.

I brought my husky here for a two-week board and train, and the results were incredible. Huskies are notoriously difficult, but the trainers here really know dogs. My dog made so much progress in such a short time without E-collar. This isn’t a typical kennel—it’s a beautiful home with a great backyard, and all the staff are trainers. I now bring her back for daycare and boarding, and she loves it! and I feel comfortable knowing she’s cared for as if by a family.
Thank you so much Laura!

We are so grateful to Connected Canine for helping us with Louie, we could absolutely tell a big difference when he came home, and could tell he was loved and cared for while there. Sara is awesome, Erin (Louie’s trainer) is amazing. Erin and Blake even came to our home to work on training after he came home. I feel they will always be there and we have made some great connections/friends. I would absolutely recommend them!🐾❤️

Sara and the Connected Canine team have become a trusted and relied upon second home for our Golden Retriever. Connected Canine is a highly professional, yet smaller scale boarding environment that provides the comfort and space desired for your pup. The best feeling is seeing how excited our pup gets as we approach the drop-off since he's developed a great friendship with many of the regular dogs and staff. I recommend Connected Canine to anyone that is looking for boarding, daycare, or training services.

Connected Canine has been the most amazing and reliable place where I take my malinois, Kuna. They didn’t allow me to see the space for the dogs for insurance reasons however were more than happy to show me a video on the spot of the entire room/ setup space, backyard, and where the mini split air conditioning is at. I receive amazing communication and check ins and always appreciate the updates and pictures! They have a treadmill there too which is great because something I was really looking for in a high quality boarding place was making sure my girl gets the exercise she needs. I am most impressed with how hands on they are, I never feel like she lacks attention when she gets home. I have met most of the staff that works there and they are all so friendly and helpful with so much information when I need help with something related to my dog!

Sara and staff do an amazing job with training and boarding. My Belgian Mal Has turned into an incredible obedient loving secure dog thanks to Sarah’s training & guidance . I only trust & leave him with Sara when I travel as well.

I highly recommend Connected Canine. Our rescue dogs come from a variety of backgrounds—some have behavioral challenges, others just needing structure and confidence. Sara and her team have been an incredible resource for our rescue and, more importantly, for our dogs. Their approach is compassionate, patient, and effective. Not only do the trainers at Connected Canine tailor their training to meet the unique needs of each dog, but they also empower our foster families with the tools, support and knowledge to continue that progress at home.
Sara is so kind and caring. She always takes great care of my dogs.

Sara and her team have been great working with our rescue dogs. Whether it is boarding or board and train, our dogs make great progress towards finding their forever home. Dedicated, passionate, knowledgeable and dog loving team, no matter the challenge.

I called a few weeks ago requesting more information about boarding and training my 2 dogs. Their website states dogs are kept in kennels but when I asked about it, my question got deferred and the lady got defensive. There is no way I’m leaving my dogs with someone that first of all is located out of their home, where there are no regulations, and no one to keep them accountable. And second I disliked the fact that I couldn’t even see where my dogs would be kept and they don’t do tours of their kennel location. That’s a RED FLAG like what is there to hide? Are the dogs staying in a garage or shed outside? Are they sent to a trainers house? No checks and no balances. Maybe I’m paranoid but I would in no way send my child somewhere with this kind of secrecy. Stay away, there are FAR better places to board and train your dogs while on vacation that have cameras, do tours, and have nothing to hide. They are also very deceptive about how many reviews they have for their training services, their site states they have over 500 reviews on Rover (but Rover has nothing to do with dog training)  Do your research before sending your family member to anyone.

Connected Canine has been an incredible partner to our rescue, Sky Sanctuary. Their thoughtful, balanced approach to training is not only highly effective, but also rooted in kindness and respect for each dog’s unique needs. The support they continue to offer—both to our team and our dogs—has made a lasting impact. We’re truly grateful for their dedication and couldn’t recommend them more highly.

I cannot say enough good things about Sara and her company Connected Canine! Sara is kind, attentive, and truly passionate about animals. She took the time to get to know our dog’s personalities and needs, and kept us updated with photos and messages throughout the stay.

Her home is clean, safe, and set up perfectly for dogs to feel comfortable and cared for. Whether it was playtime, walks, or cuddle sessions, our pup came home happy, healthy, and clearly well-loved.

We feel so grateful to have found someone we can fully trust, and we will absolutely be using Sara again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable, warm, and professional dog boarding experience!

If you are looking for the BEST dog training and boarding this is THE SPOT! Sara is wonderful, knowledgeable and kind. She is a true professional and trains the whole dog not just the issues brought to her to fix. It a market full of trainers leaving owners with less then desirable results I am always so excited to tell my friends about Connected Canine! I cannot  recommend them enough! Thank you Sara and team for all you do for the pups and their families.
Great people

The progress Connected Canine is able to make, in a short amount of time, is amazing.

Leo is a stereotypical red nosed pit. High energy, high alert, vocal, expressive. Hard to walk. Impossible to take anywhere. Overly friendly...yet also overly protective.

Sara immediately, accurately, identified that he was over stimulated and lacked confidence.

Leo went through the board & train program. He came home a different dog. He has a personality and that has not changed. But he has much better impulse control and improved manners. He understands several commands. He walks politely. He can handle a trip to the park and various stores. He just has a much better quality of life today.

Most important, to me, is that she put us in a place to continue working & growing together. Training is a continual process.

Thank you to the whole Connected Canine team!

Connected Canine is genuinely amazing! We board our dog with them when we're out of town and we also use them for weekly doggie daycare. Whenever our dog is in their care, I never worry because I know he's in the best hands.

Sara and her crew understand dog temperament and thus not all dogs play well with each other. It's amazing to me that my dog has accepted Sara and her crew from day 1, even letting them pet him and play with him. The boarding facility and services is the best in the valley.

Our pup absolutely loves going to stay with Sara and her team. He always comes home happy and tired. He has always had a hard time making friends but has finally broken out of his shell staying with Sara. Her vast expertise in dog training and behavior have helped him to finally feel comfortable enough to make fellow doggy friends and it makes me so happy. Couldn’t recommend them more!
Sara and her team are incredible! Everyone is so nice and knowledgeable! I highly recommend using them for your boarding and training needs!!
My dog loves visiting the ladies at Connected Canine! I bring my dog here because they are professionals in canine behavior and Leo comes home from boarding a happy boy!
Connected Canine and Sara are great. We love sending our dog Bruno here. A great environment and he's always very well cared for.

We are so thankful for Sara and Connected Canine! I first found Sara online and chose her because of her expertise with timid, anxious dogs. I also like that she not only provides the training we need, but she also provides the occasional boarding we need. I love that she reinforces training while our dog stays with her and provides play times with dogs with matching temperaments. Sara is both confident and caring, and she has gone above and beyond to serve us. Our dog LOVES Sara and LOVES staying with her. We always know she's in good hands with Sara.
Sara is the absolute best!! I wouldn’t trust my baby with anyone else. He absolutely loves staying with her!

Sara and her team have been wonderful for us and our complicated older gal, Kona. We adopted Kona from the Maricopa County Shelter, and she tends to be reactive to other dogs and suffers from extreme separation anxiety. Sara, with her extraordinary experience and kindness, is able to calm Kona and, even more, reduce her reactivity with play, training, and positive stimulation. Kona now has buddies at Sara's and acts bouncy when we take her there. Highly recommend! If she can care for Kona, she can care for any dog.

Sara and her team at Connected Canine provide a safe and nurturing space for my super anxious senior pup. My dog has made a couple of furry friends at "Camp Sara" (as we call it). Sara's summary of Kona's stays are specific, informative, and endearing. Connected Canine has been our best find in North Central Phoenix for dog boarding.

Sara and her team are the best! I have a high energy German shepherd puppy that requires a lot of brain and physical activity and they put in the time to work with him and care for him. He’s always excited to be dropped off so I know he loves it!

Connected Canine run by Sara is my go to for boarding my dog Grizzy when I’m out of town. She also trained him in a 4 week puppy boot camp shortly after I adopted him and he’s doing great. I highly recommend Sara to anyone looking for a reliable boarding, training and daycare provider.
My Gracie love’s going to daycare!

As a travel nurse it’s always hard to find good care for my dog Kai, but I can honestly say Connected Canine has been one of the best experiences I’ve had. Sara is very nice and responsive with any requests or questions I have. My dog is always happy to see her and never nervous when I drop him off. I can always count that he’s in good hands.

Sara has been watching our pup Murphy regularly, and we couldn’t ask for a better pet sitter! She is incredibly reliable, caring, and truly loves animals. Every time we leave our dog in her care, I know they’re in the best hands. She keeps me updated with photos and messages, which gives me peace of mind while we’re away.

Not only does Sara make sure our pup is well-fed, exercised, and happy, but she also gives him plenty of love and attention. I always come home to a content and well-cared-for pup. If you’re looking for a trustworthy and dedicated dog sitter, I highly recommend Sara!
Sara is amazing. She genuinely cares and my Sadie loves going there.
Sara and her team at Connected Canine are the absolute best!!! Boarding my energetic golden retriever with Sara has been a great experience and I can’t imagine leaving her with anyone more caring!
Wonderful dependable care. Good facility setup
They do such an amazing job of taking care of my puppy and staying in contact with me about how he is doing during the day.   My little guy loves going to daycare!  I am so lucky to have found them.

Connected Canine and Sara are the best! To be honest, our dog Olive would probably move in with "Aunt Sara" if she had the choice. We've used Sara for daycare and boarding and have had a wonderful experience.

I'm an anxious dog mother and I feel totally confident leaving Olive with Sara. Her experience with dogs and her focus on safety, structure, and creating the best environment for each dog puts my anxieties at ease! The space is huge and secure and Olive (who is a Borzoi and can sprint very fast) loves running laps around her yard.

Sara's also amazing at communicating with us! In addition to the CUTEST photos and videos of the dogs playing, she's very attentive to how each dog is doing. One time she noticed Olive wasn't quite her usual playful self and immediately gave us a heads-up, which I appreciated.

Honestly, can't recommend Connected Canine enough.

If we could give Connected Canine more than five stars, we would! We have brought our puppy, Franklin (Frankie), to Connected Canine multiple times over the past six months - both for daycare and for boarding when we travel. Sara and her team epitomize compassionate pet care. They are fantastic with our dog and take great care in making sure his needs are met. Frankie is always excited when we arrive, and comes home happy, well-socialized, and worn out from a fun-filled stay. Unlike large kennels or typical daycare facilities, we love that Sara offers a warm, home-like environment for our pup, and we have complete peace of mind knowing Frankie is receiving personalized attention and playtime with other dogs in a safe and structured environment. We are so grateful to have found a place where Frankie is treated like family and recommend Connected Canine to anyone who needs daycare or boarding services.

Sara and her team are amazing. My two frenchies love to go to her daycare. The facilities are clean and Sara closely evaluates personality types to ensure safety. Booking is easy and Sara is very responsive. Highly recommend her services!

Connected Canine was wonderful.  Zeus stayed here on vacation while we went on ours.  The facility is beautiful, clean and he didn't miss a beat from his normal life at home.  He had social interaction, treats, and love.

While the vacation was beautiful, Zeus had a better time and more fun on his trip.  It happens.

Thank you Connected Canine for taking great care of him.
My pup LOVES her little summer camps here!. Been using Sara for all our vacations for over a year and the pup always returns happy clean and healthy!
